shortdesc.ph: Stops or resumes publishing the local audio stream.
Stops or resumes publishing the local audio stream.

section.note: The method does not affect any ongoing audio recording because it does not disable the audio capturing device. Call this method after calling joinChannel. When using spatial audio, if you need to set whether to stop publishing the local audio stream, Agora recommends calling this method instead of the method with the same name under . After this method is successfully called, the and callbacks are triggered on the remote client.
